title: Bring Up the Bodies
author: Hilary Mantel
summary: Thomas Cromwell, the king's fixer, turns to bringing down Anne Boleyn when Henry VIII tires of her and wants a new queen, in this sequel to Wolf Hall.
readIf: you like intelligent, closely observed Tudor court drama and enjoyed Wolf Hall.
skipIf: you have not read Wolf Hall or dislike present-tense, dense historical prose.
